scope: Deterministic pacing translation for Canvas weekly proposals (Phase 3 Chief of Staff loop).
principle: SOURCE token -> deterministic canonical translation -> precedent retrieval -> local model only for unresolved interpretation. The local model must not override deterministic OWNER_POLICY.

shurleyLesson.note: A pacing token shaped N.M means Chapter N, Lesson M. Always include the word 'Chapter'. Do not output bare N.M when the deterministic rule can expand it.

classroomPractice.note: Lesson and CP tokens render as separate In Class bullets. Space-separated forms such as '7.4 CP 27' are valid.

assignment.dueDate: first Wednesday occurrence when a CP recurs across multiple days; otherwise the scheduled day

dueDatePolicy.note: OWNER_POLICY. CP27 recurs Tue/Wed/Fri and is due Wednesday, November 4. CP26 occurs Monday and is due Monday, November 2.

assignment.deduplication: one assignment per unique CP number per instructional week

assignmentPolicy.rule: Automatically create Canvas assignments ONLY for Chapter Tests and Classroom Practices. Spelling Tests are handled by the Reading/Spelling engine. All other Shurley work is teacher-managed manually.

announcementPolicy.note: Only a Shurley Chapter Test triggers the assessment announcement plan. Checkups and Reviews do not.

atHomePolicy.rule: Never create At Home for ordinary Shurley lessons, Classroom Practice, Checkups, or Reviews. At Home may contain only explicit, teacher-approved preparation for an upcoming Chapter Test.

assignmentPolicy.rule: Automatically create Canvas assignments ONLY for Chapter Tests and Quizzes explicitly classified by authoritative curriculum/source rules. A token containing 'Check' is NOT automatically a quiz.

announcementPolicy.rule: Only a deterministic Science token explicitly classified as a test/quiz triggers the global assessment communication engine. A chapter 'Check' does not. Q2W1 has no test/quiz, so announcements = 0.

science.note: Output must always include the unit name and the word 'Chapter' when chapter-based, plus pacing-guide activity/check/review wording. Do not infer a unit name from model general knowledge.

assignmentPolicy.rule: Automatically create Canvas assignments ONLY for Chapter Tests and Quizzes. History assignment auto-creation has historically been disabled; do not infer.

history.q2Behavior: redirect-only; no normal Q2 History instructional generation
history.redirectMessage: We are learning Science this track! Please check the Science Canvas page for this week's agenda, assignments, and updates.
history.note: Do not invent a History unit name. Use only canonical unit mapping or explicit pacing context. If unavailable, leave expanded wording unresolved rather than guessing.
